questions.prompt: What systems must you send data to, and receive data from?
Which of those integrations are allowed to be down without blocking your core product?
questions.defaultHint: All of them -- core create/read/update/delete must not depend on external systems.

questions.prompt: Do customers need to receive your events (webhooks, exports)?
Must anything run inside the customer's own network?
Is email, SMS or push required, and who supplies the transport?
questions.defaultHint: Email only, via a transactional email provider.
